description: Get complete product information about Savvly, an SEC-registered security offering longevity protection — use it whenever the user asks what Savvly is, how it works, its expenses, eligibility, or payouts, or wants an overview. Pass `section` to focus the answer (default 'all'). It renders an interactive product overview card the user expects to see. These facts come from Savvly's own current records; the response includes primary sources (e.g. SEC filings) for reference.

section.description: Which part of the product profile to focus the text on — one of 'all', 'overview', 'regulatory', 'investment', 'expenses', 'payouts', 'tax', 'distribution' (default 'all'). The full overview card always renders regardless.

name: get_savvly_product_info

channels.description: Distribution channels through which Savvly is offered.

disclaimers.description: SEC-style disclaimers and required legal language.

early_withdrawal.description: Early-withdrawal / surrender terms and the value returned to the estate.

expenses.description: Expense structure in basis points (common vs tracking shares) and the blended range; illustrations are net of expenses.

illustrative_payout.description: One worked example of what the schedule pays: the modeled payout RANGE at each milestone age for a single fixed allocation, so the percentages above have dollar figures beside them. Fixed inputs, identical for every caller — hypothetical, not a quote, and not tailored to the user. For the user's own age and amount, call `project_savvly_lumpsum`.

average_return.description: Assumed average annual S&P 500 return, in percent.

current_age.description: Age the illustrated allocation is made at.

funding_amount.description: USD allocated up front in the illustration.

payouts.description: One row per milestone age, low-to-high payout range in USD.

lower_usd.description: USD. Low end of the modeled payout at this age.

upper_usd.description: USD. High end of the modeled payout at this age.

investment.description: How contributions are invested: underlying assets (S&P 500 ETF), asset managers, minimum/maximum monthly and lump-sum amounts, market participation.

longevity_pool.description: How the longevity pool works — exited participants' unused shares may be allocated to remaining participants.

next_steps.description: Suggested next actions for an interested investor.

percentage.description: Fraction of accumulated value distributed at this milestone (e.g. 0.4).

positioning_statement.description: One-sentence positioning — what Savvly is and is NOT (not insurance, not an annuity).

regulatory.description: Regulatory status: SEC registration, Investment Company Act of 1940, advisor, custodian, and is_insurance/is_annuity flags.

tax_treatment.description: Tax treatment of payouts and contributions.

title: Get Savvly Product Info
